Opening this issue from your own GitHub account is your consent to list that account in the
[Repolis city gallery](https://hyeonsangjeon.github.io/Repolis/gallery.html).

- The gallery shows only public GitHub metadata, drawn as your city card.
- A listing is not an endorsement or an affiliation.
- You can ask for removal at any time with the **Remove my town from the city gallery** issue.
